_comment: DSP algorithm template library. Each entry defines a named signal-processing archetype with its Faust code skeleton, default parameter values, acoustic tags for semantic matching, and AST node type. The ast_builder.py module uses these templates as starting points before the LLM refines them. Tags are matched against the parsed Vibe intent to select the closest archetype.

templates.name: Room Reverb
templates.description: General-purpose Freeverb-style room reverb with adjustable size, damping, and wet/dry mix.

templates.name: Feedback Delay / Echo
templates.description: Single tap feedback delay producing repeating echoes. Delay time and feedback gain are user-controllable.

templates.name: Low-Pass Filter
templates.description: Butterworth low-pass filter. Rolls off high-frequency content to produce warmth, muffled textures, or telephone effects.

templates.name: High-Pass Filter
templates.description: Butterworth high-pass filter. Removes low-frequency content to produce airy, bright, or telephone-like textures.

templates.name: Soft Saturation / Tape Drive
templates.description: Cubic soft-clipping saturation. Models the gentle harmonic distortion of overdriven tape or analog circuits.

templates.name: Tremolo
templates.description: Amplitude modulation via sine LFO. Produces rhythmic volume fluctuations from gentle flickering to rapid chopping.

templates.name: Chorus / Ensemble
templates.description: Multi-voice chorus using short modulated delays. Adds width, richness, and a sense of ensemble playing.

templates.name: Bitcrusher / Lo-Fi
templates.description: Bit-depth and sample-rate reduction. Produces digital harshness, retro 8-bit textures, or extreme degradation.

templates.name: Noise Gate
templates.description: Attenuates signal below a threshold. Silences background hiss between audio events.

templates.name: Compressor
templates.description: Dynamic range compression. Tightens transients and raises perceived loudness.
